summary: Reviewed the global board dogfood slice: browser automation uses Playwright-managed Chromium headless shell instead of system Chrome, the dogfood test drives command-backed reserve/refused-close/verified-close and portfolio unblock paths, verified cards can close while derived columns remain non-droppable, close commands carry an explicit no_repo_changes dirty-path reason, and getting-started docs cover the global manager loop. No blocking review findings remain.
